subject.title: [Feature]: sessions_search — full-text search over the agent's own session transcripts

question: Should OpenClaw add a core agent-facing `sessions_search` tool and gateway `sessions.search` method, or keep session-content recall in memory/UI surfaces for now?
rationale: The request adds a new core capability and sensitive transcript-access surface, so automation cannot safely choose the permanent product and security boundary.

options.title: Approve core search seam
options.body: Implement a bounded `sessions_search`/`sessions.search` path with visibility checks, redaction, SQLite indexing, backfill, pruning, and follow-up UI reuse.

options.title: Keep memory/UI-only
options.body: Do not add a core tool yet; track improvements through `memory_search` session corpus and separate UI/mobile search issues.

options.title: Defer for security design
options.body: Pause implementation until maintainers define the transcript indexing, snippet redaction, retention, and deletion requirements.

recommendation.title: Approve core search seam
recommendation.body: Implement a bounded `sessions_search`/`sessions.search` path with visibility checks, redaction, SQLite indexing, backfill, pruning, and follow-up UI reuse.

likelyOwner.reason: This person authored the issue and has recent adjacent session-management commits across the gateway and apps.
